messages.subject: A cross-border leadership profile for Citi | Government, industry and emerging markets
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Fraser,

I am writing with a focused introduction shaped around Citi's global model and the value of leaders who understand both financial services and the operating realities of multinational clients in emerging markets.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, after progressing through government relations, corporate affairs, compliance and executive coordination since 2020. Before entering the resources sector, I spent five years with Scotiabank Guyana. Across more than 12 years, my work has developed at the intersection of regulated finance, international investment, government, sustainability, stakeholder strategy and country-level execution.

My contribution to Citi would sit where client strategy meets government, regulation and complex operating environments. I bring direct experience supporting a major international investor through senior engagement with ministries, regulators and public institutions, while coordinating internal execution across operations, legal, finance, HSE, HR, procurement, security and technical teams. I also bring practical exposure to industrial energy transition, carbon-accounting governance and the stakeholder requirements attached to large capital-intensive operations.

This combination gives me a differentiated perspective on the needs of multinational clients operating across natural resources, infrastructure, energy transition and other regulated sectors. I see strong alignment with senior opportunities across Citi International, Corporate Affairs, Government Affairs, strategic client engagement, sustainability, country leadership and related cross-border mandates.

I have attached a concise Citi-specific executive CV. I would value either a brief conversation or your direction to the senior leader best placed to assess where this profile would add the greatest value within Citi.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
